functions.name: IsExpired
functions.docs: Return true if elapsed time is greater than the initially requested timeout

functions.name: Never
functions.docs: Create a timeout that will never return true for IsExpired

functions.name: WillNeverExpire
functions.docs: Returns true if this was created from Never and does not need to be repeatedly checked

functions.name: AlwaysExpired
functions.docs: Create a timeout that will always return true for IsExpired

functions.name: IsAlwaysExpired
functions.docs: Returns true if this was created from AlwaysExpired and does not need to be repeatedly checked

functions.name: SetToExpired
functions.docs: Set this timeout to explicitly expired without recalculating start time

functions.name: GetElapsedSeconds
functions.docs: Returns time since the timeout was created, in seconds

functions.name: GetRemainingSeconds
functions.docs: Returns time left until the timeout expires (which can be negative) in seconds

functions.name: GetTimeoutSeconds
functions.docs: Returns duration of timeout in seconds

functions.name: SetTimeoutSeconds
functions.docs: Sets the timeout to new value in seconds

functions.name: ModifyTimeoutSeconds
functions.docs: Safely modify the remaining time by adding the delta time in seconds to the timeout

functions.name: GetElapsedTime
functions.docs: Returns time since the timeout was created, as a timespan

functions.name: GetRemainingTime
functions.docs: Returns time left until the timeout expires (which can be negative) as a timespan

functions.name: GetTimeoutValue
functions.docs: Returns duration of timeout as a timespan

functions.name: GetRemainingRoundedUpMilliseconds
functions.docs:
Intended for use in waiting functions, e.g. `FEvent::Wait()`
returns the whole number (rounded up) of remaining milliseconds, clamped into [0, MAX_uint32] range
